education.description: Focus on Machine Learning & Signal Processing. Thesis in Generative AI for musical synthesizers. Active in entrepreneurial & cultural student initiatives.

bullets: Documented a 15,000 km motorcycle expedition from Switzerland to Kazakhstan (via Iran, Afghanistan).
Navigated extreme environments (46°C heat, 4600m altitude, sandstorms).
Managed crises including interrogations by IRGC/Taliban and navigating war zones.
Currently writing a non-fiction book on resilience and cross-cultural experiences.
Supported 20+ startups in acceleration (workshops, pitch sessions, ideation).
Built internal operational systems (Airtable, Make, Notion) to automate workflows.
Developed an internal AI-powered RAG startup search tool for startup scouting.
Researched and evaluated startups, mapping key trends and opportunities.
Assisted interdisciplinary groups ideating sustainable mobility solutions (Design Thinking).
Led group discussions and provided targeted feedback to refine ideas.
Facilitated a dynamic learning environment encouraging critical thinking.
Mentored Hawassa University student entrepreneurs from concept to prototype.
Taught business development methods (Design Thinking, Lean Canvas).
Led early-stage dev of a digital twin of Switzerland for urban planning insights.
Helped seek CHF 200k in seed funding from SwissPost.
Actively shaped the Club's strategic direction for the next 10 years.
Managed a 15-person team through COVID-19; adapted strategies to virtual/hybrid.
Organized 20+ events with a total budget of >CHF 150k.
Coordinated InCube Challenge logistics (CHF 100k budget).
Orchestrated Singapore hub operations, enhancing international collaboration.
Conceptualized strategic pivot to 'InCube Alpine Edition' during COVID.
Resident DJ at bQm Bar and board member of DJ Events ETH.
Founded Gold Coast Productions to promote house music in Zurich.
